Heatmap

A grid of cells shaded on one sequential scale, e.g. requests per hour and weekday, with a scale strip and tooltips.

Source src/react/charts/Heatmap.tsx See it in the gallery

Props

PropTypeDefaultDescription
rowsrequired string[] — Row labels, top to bottom (e.g. weekdays).
columnsrequired string[] — Column labels, left to right (e.g. hours).
valuesrequired Array<Array<number | null | undefined>> — values[row][column]; null or undefined means no data (drawn as an empty cell).
labelrequired string — —
cellHeight number 22 Cell height in px. Default 22.
steps number 6 Number of colour steps. Default 6 — quantised steps read more reliably than a smooth ramp.
min number — Fix the range (default: the data's min and max).
max number — —
table "hidden" | "toggle" "hidden" —
format (value: number) => string — —
locale string — —
emptyText ReactNode — —

Also accepts every native <div> attribute, passed through to the root element.

CSS classes

The classes this component renders, for styling the same thing in plain HTML.

.oq-chart .oq-chart--heatmap .oq-chart__plot .oq-chart__svg .oq-chart__tick .oq-heatmap__cell .oq-heatmap__scale .oq-heatmap__scroll .oq-heatmap__step
